StarclipStarclip

Clipboard manager

v0.2.7

A local-first clipboard manager powered by Rust, keeping track of what you copy.

  • Store text, images and file paths locally in SQLite, with deduplication, search and category filters
  • Save code snippets in Starcode; turn code and text into shareable cards and handwritten notes with Stardraw
  • Simplified Chinese / English interface and in-app updates with signature verification
RustmacOS · Apple SiliconWindows x64
brew install --cask stardreamtech/tap/starclip

StarshotStarshot

Capture · Annotate · Pin

v0.3.3

A local-first desktop tool for screenshots, annotation, pinned images and image styling. Capture your inspiration.

  • Pin images on top; add gradients, rounded corners and shadows; export PNG / JPEG

StarVaultStarVault

AI conversation archive

v0.1.4

Your AI memories belong to you. A local-first conversation archive with incremental backups, attachments and Skill migration, available as a desktop app, CLI and MCP server.

  • Archive Codex, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, WorkBuddy, OpenClaw and DeepSeek Harness sessions, and import ChatGPT conversations
  • Sync conversation text and indexes to a private GitHub repository; keep attachments and raw records local
  • Let assistants search existing archives through MCP
PythonDesktop · macOS Apple SiliconCLI · macOS / Linux

StarLockStarLock

CAPTCHA SDK and service

v0.8.0 · Development

Hosted CAPTCHA components and server-side verification for websites, with self-hosting support.

  • Digits, characters, arithmetic, straight / curved puzzles, ring rotation, ordered text clicks and semantic image grids
  • Bézier easing, shape rotation, decoy cutouts and compact keyboard-accessible dialogs
  • Hosted api.js, Vue / React components and Python / Go backend SDKs
FastAPI · RedisTypeScript · Vue 3 · ReactMIT

Try all eight challenge types online. Multi-round image replacement, invisible risk checks and behavior scoring are planned.

StarWatchStarWatch

Website monitoring · API checks

In development

A self-hosted scheduled monitoring platform for selected website and API fields, with historical comparisons.

  • Cron and interval scheduling for website monitoring, API assertions and short load tests
  • Extract HTML, JSON and text, and review additions, deletions and changes line by line
  • Tasks, run history, snapshots and notifications, with separate fetcher and scheduler processes

Homebrew Tap

Install a star with one command

The Homebrew tap maintained by StarDreamTech currently provides desktop apps for Apple Silicon Macs. Download Windows installers from each project's releases.

The apps use ad-hoc signatures and are not notarized by Apple. macOS may block the first launch; read the release notes before installing.

zsh
# Starclip · Clipboard
$ brew install --cask stardreamtech/tap/starclip
# Starshot · Screenshots
$ brew install --cask stardreamtech/tap/starshot
# StarVault · AI conversation archive
$ brew install --cask stardreamtech/tap/starvault
StarDreamTech/homebrew-tap ↗
